column3: Well then, I guess I'll try asking her right away.
Hey Kirino, I have something I would like to discuss with you.
If it's anything weird... Well, I don't think it'll be anything like that.
Of course. What kind of world is there a brother who would sexually harass their little sister?
Even though you don't intend to, there's been plenty of times where it ended up like that.
I have no memories of the sort.
Right, right. So then, what is it?
